live message retains candidate until its image reference is removed
isolated physical copy survives GC deletion of live original
corrupt authority prevents cleanup of every candidate
resource unlink primitive has no live reference fence and independent copy survives
external manifest alone cannot retain live candidate and is not itself a candidate
cancel while real cleanup waits for maintenance leaves media intact
hidden media now refuses partial export while historical omission evidence remains retained
unknown top level copy namespace blocks full backup instead of partial success
registered normal media enters authenticated full backup with exact fake bytes
